pytest-needs-pythonpath-src.fact: Tests in this repository must be run with PYTHONPATH=src set, for example `PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest -q`, because running pytest without it fails with ImportError.

make-fixtures-before-tests.fact: Run `make fixtures` before the test suite, since tests such as tests/test_style.py fail with FileNotFoundError until the fixtures are generated.

project-formatter-make-fmt.fact: Format src/ with `make fmt`, which runs scripts/fmt.py; CI checks that src/ is formatted with this project formatter and the style test fails otherwise.

gen-fixtures-script.fact: Run `python scripts/gen_fixtures.py` before the test suite, since tests such as tests/test_style.py fail with FileNotFoundError until the fixtures are generated.
